title: Fair shares
summary: Split the money three people earned together.
intro: Three people finished a project that earned $10,000. Each point you give is $100. The facts change with each question.

questions.scenario: Avery worked 80 hours. Blake worked 20 hours. Casey contributed almost nothing.

questions.prompt: Same project. Now you learn Casey spent those weeks caring for a sick child and is struggling to pay bills.

options.label: Casey — caring for a sick child

questions.prompt: Now you learn Avery had lots of free time, and Blake's 20 hours produced most of the value.

options.label: Blake — 20 hours, most of the value

questions.prompt: Last twist: the whole project was Casey's idea.
Two people do the same job equally well. One is supporting three children alone.

options.label: Pay whoever produces more, even slightly

questions.prompt: Should people keep what they earn, even when others are struggling?
